fields.title: Photography101
fields.description: Aside from editing photos, I also enjoy taking pictures. I bought a DSLR camera seven years ago, and it is still working today. I capture moments during my travels, although I haven't ventured too far. I typically take photos at the beach, when hanging out with friends, or during a staycation at home. Since I ride a motorbike, I occasionally pull over to the side of the road to capture the surroundings.
